Running it
----------
Copy simcity.aqx and simcity.bin to the same place on the Aquarius+'s SD
card (or the folder of the emulator's file system) and run simcity.aqx.
The .aqx is the loader: it needs simcity.bin beside it.

From BASIC enter the command: RUN simcity.aqx and the game will start.

The game uses the 40 x 25 bitmap screen, the AY-3-8910 for sound effects
and the ESP file system for saving cities.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted capitals: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, sound

The pointer and the mouse
-------------------------
There is one arrow on the screen, and it is the cursor.  The keys move it
(the keys above: shifted, it moves faster) and the mouse on the ESP32 (USB) moves it too, so
either can be used at any time.
  Space, Enter    the left button: build with the tool, choose in a menu
                  or on the tool icons, jump on the mini map
  right button    the same as Esc/X: the game menu, and out of a screen
  at the edge     the map scrolls when the arrow is at the edge of it
In the menus, the budget, the evaluation and the file and scenario screens
the mouse works as the cursor keys (a few pixels of movement is a key).

In the menu the cursor up and down (or Q and A) move, Space or Enter
chooses, X closes it.  Options that show a value (SPEED: NORMAL) change
as you choose them.  Placing a power plant asks for coal or nuclear when
there is the money for both.

Saving and loading ask for a file name: type it and press Enter.
